label: Forward illumination receipt model
definition: In the analyst U/R/L quantity circuit, an independently supplied emission amount traverses an open path unchanged, or a closed path contributes zero. U is positive solar input arriving at one fixed air region, R is that region's receptive condition, and L is positivity of the receiver's response: the sum of solar and lamp inputs when receptive, zero otherwise. The sun and lamp bear their respective arrival events, while the same air region bears R and L. The response is illumination of air, not its substantial existence.
note: All amounts are uncalibrated Nat tokens, not empirical radiometry. The two path gates, source amounts and receptive flag are independent scenario inputs. The forward body has no stored/self-emission term at the receiver and does not define U by successful L: a nonreceptive state can have U positive and L absent. This gives positive directed transmission/receiving content in the stipulated circuit; identifying it with actual optical production is a separate OPEN application premise. Reuses JointGroups.Groups/Exercise and PreservationMeaning.SourceCut/AvailableRecord/RecordCovered. Solar-only admission permits the solar record and restricts allowed scenarios to zero arriving lamp input; expanded admission permits both records without that restriction. Both keep exactly the same L event. Records are alternative sufficient input sets for positive illumination, not complete explanations of total response magnitude or substantial esse. RecordCovered is proved inside these stipulated equations; it is not imported as an opaque assumption. Exercise remains an independent performed predicate; correspondence to admitted active input and R yields coherence, while empty exercise with the same positive response remains possible. The source account motivating U as contributor and R as enabler, the exact emission/path/receiver abstractions, actual-exercise burdens, consumer audit and complete proposed outcome are in docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md, Interpreting the illumination U/R/L receipt (2026-11-17). No original sourced preservation declaration or allowance changes. No structural causal order, metaphysical source absence, physical calibration or esse-CausesIn bridge is asserted.
